deploy-bot: Rollout complete to prod (region: us-west, cohort: 100%) — version redwood-runtime@v2.14.3
synth-bot: Postdeploy synthetic run started (10k reqs) — checking chat/generate and embed endpoints
synth-bot: Quick summary: p95 latency increased 18% vs baseline in us-west for chat/generate; error rate 0.12% (baseline 0.02%)
jamie: link to telemetry? can you paste the p95 numbers and baseline window? :thinking:
sasha: baseline window = last successful deploy (v2.14.2) 1h rolling. p50/p95 now: p50 120ms -> 130ms, p95 420ms -> 500ms. errors are 502s from inference-proxy
sasha: paste logs: ```2026-03-20T14:16:31Z inference-proxy us-west 502 "KV cache miss overflow" shard=7``` 
maria: hmm 502s at p95 is concerning. Any region-only? or global?
synth-bot: Region breakdown: us-west p95 +18%, eu1 +2%, apac unchanged
jamie: ok hold rollout, pin region us-west to v2.14.2 and abort further canary promotions. Oncall-bot escalate to eng-runtime
oncall-bot: @eng-runtime ping — postdeploy synthetic flagged elevated 502s in us-west; request quick triage
sasha: created issue: https://go/issue/INFR-4921 with logs and synth run link
maria: quick mitigation: revert inference-proxy config tweak that landed in v2.14.3 (connection_pool settings). sasha can you push the rollback? If not, we can route traffic away
sasha: I can hotpatch config in us-west -> rolling restart routing 10% at a time, will follow with smoke runs
jamie: thanks. once restarted, run `curl -sS https://synth.redwood.internal/run?id=2805010001` and paste the summary
sasha: started hotpatch at 2805010200
synth-bot: small-run (1k reqs) after hotpatch: p95 back down ~430ms, errors 0.03% — still slightly above baseline
maria: good. keep pinned and monitor for 30m. schedule a follow-up postmortem if it doesn't fully resolve
jamie: noted. updating release notes: added entry 'postdeploy: us-west p95 spike, pinned v2.14.2 for us-west'
sasha: adding rollout notes to changelog and will create a release incident doc
deploy-bot: Rollout status: held; regions pinned: us-west -> v2.14.2; global paused
jamie: thanks team :thumbsup:
